name: Fathom HQ
tagline: Financial reporting, KPI dashboards, consolidations, and forecasting for businesses

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked 2026-07-30; Starter shown around $53/month in crawler output, with plan/currency display potentially varying.

verdictSummary: A KPI dashboard over accounting exports is buildable, but Fathom's value is accounting integrations, consolidation, forecasting, polished board reports, and accountant workflows.
coreLoopDIY: Import Xero/QuickBooks CSV/API data, calculate KPIs, build dashboards, and export PDF reports.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because board/advisor reporting needs accuracy, comparability, and presentable output.

priorArt.name: Metabase
priorArt.desc: Open-source BI/dashboard platform that can power custom KPI dashboards.

notes: Interesting finance ops case: charting is easy, accounting semantics are harder.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Fathom HQ (Financial reporting, KPI dashboards, consolidations, and forecasting for businesses). Requirements:

- Core loop: Import Xero/QuickBooks CSV/API data, calculate KPIs, build dashboards, and export PDF reports.
- Needs: accounting exports/API.
- Needs: data model.
- Needs: chart/report builder.
- Needs: PDF export.
- Needs: hosted app.
- Needs: permissions.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: accounting integrations; consolidation; templates.
